courses.title: Shedding the Old to Enter the Magnificent Wild: A Women's Third Rite of Passage
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur, California, led by Jovinna, honouring perimenopause and menopause as a sacred passage rather than only a biological phase. The days combine conscious dance, time in nature, storytelling and community, with rituals and a ceremony of renewal.

flags: Restored under the new health rule: the workshop names perimenopause and menopause but frames them as 'sacred passages' and offers dance, nature and ritual; no claim to treat symptoms and nothing about medical care.
